## Description

Describe the observed problem clearly.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Send the request or run the command.
2. Provide the relevant input.
3. Observe the result.

## Expected behavior

Describe the correct result, status code, or response body.

## Actual behavior

Describe what happens instead.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A regression test reproduces the original failure.
- [ ] The underlying cause is fixed.
- [ ] Existing tests and lint still pass.
- [ ] The relevant documentation is updated when needed.
